title: Dual-flow convolutional neural network for automatic measurement of left ventricular ejection fraction and global longitudinal strain in echocardiography.
summary: Echo-DFCNN, a dual-flow convolutional neural network, synchronously measured LVEF and GLS from echocardiography videos across internal, external and cardiac-MR validation cohorts.
ai_technology: Echo-DFCNN, a dual-flow convolutional neural network, synchronously measured LVEF and GLS from echocardiography videos across internal, external and cardiac-MR validation cohorts.
organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: The model used 500 internal patients, 363 external patients and 67 CMR cases; internal agreement with manual measurements was ICC 0.927 for LVEF and 0.913 for GLS, while clinical outcome benefit was not assessed.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Echo-DFCNN, a dual-flow convolutional neural network, synchronously measured LVEF and GLS from echocardiography videos across internal, external and cardiac-MR validation cohorts.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
